title: Health Dynamics of India 2022-23: Doctor-Population Ratio at 1:811
summary: MoHFW report: 13.88 lakh allopathic + 7.51 lakh AYUSH doctors; doctor-population ratio 1:811 (beats WHO 1:1000 norm); nurse ratio 2.23/1000.
